slot.brief: A parallel-plate capacitor with a dielectric slab partially inserted (or two dielectrics stacked); treat as series/parallel combination and find equivalent capacitance and stored energy.

stem: A parallel-plate capacitor of separation $d$ and air capacitance $C_0$ is charged to $Q$ and disconnected from the source. Two full-area dielectric sheets, each of thickness $d/2$ and dielectric constants $2$ and $6$, fill the gap in series. The stored energy is

verdicts.working: For the two layers, their capacitances are 4C₀ and 12C₀. In series, C_eff = 3C₀. The capacitor is disconnected, so Q is fixed; U = Q²/(2C_eff) = Q²/(6C₀).

working:
$C_1=2(2C_0)=4C_0$, $C_2=2(6C_0)=12C_0$
$\dfrac{1}{C_{\mathrm{eq}}}=\dfrac{1}{4C_0}+\dfrac{1}{12C_0}\Rightarrow C_{\mathrm{eq}}=3C_0$
$U=\dfrac{Q^2}{2C_{\mathrm{eq}}}=\dfrac{Q^2}{6C_0}$

Independent check: For the two layers, their capacitances are 4C₀ and 12C₀. In series, C_eff = 3C₀. The capacitor is disconnected, so Q is fixed; U = Q²/(2C_eff) = Q²/(6C₀).
